# Differential cases for the routines of G3's load_db() and save_db() that
# read or write files of their own or set up globals: load_system(),
# save_system(), cleanup_posts(), load_orders(), save_orders(),
# init_trade_routes(), save_trade_routes(), determine_map_edges() and
# rename_act_join_files(), at G3 47535543d83fbc5649d54b63b49e578f2b11ab1c.
#
# tools/loadsave-compat/run.sh feeds this file to a C driver built from the
# pinned sources and records its output in loadsave-c-output.txt;
# TestLoadSaveMatchesC feeds it to the Go port and requires the same
# output.
#
# Each "section NAME" line starts a section. Every section runs in a fresh
# process (a fresh world, after glob_init()) in a fresh, empty directory,
# with umask 022, so a section may end in a failed assertion or a crash.
# libdir starts as "lib". stderr goes to the same place as stdout, in
# order, and run.sh lists the directory's tree after "exit STATUS".
#
# One operation per line; a line that starts with '#' is a comment, and
# blank lines are skipped. TEXT is the rest of the line after one space,
# with \xHH and \\ escapes; with no space it is empty. NAME and MODE are
# one word. Every operation but put and putl is echoed, after "> ".
#
#   put NAME TEXT    append TEXT to file NAME
#   putl NAME TEXT   append TEXT and a newline to file NAME
#   mkdir TEXT       mkdir(TEXT, 0755)
#   rm TEXT          unlink(TEXT)
#   chmod MODE TEXT  chmod(TEXT, MODE), MODE in octal
#   libdir TEXT      libdir = TEXT
#   seed TEXT        what -G TEXT sets: trade_route_seed_pending, and
#                    trade_route_seed_value = strtoull(TEXT, NULL, 0)
#   newplayer TEXT   append atoi(TEXT) to new_players
#   trade            init_trade_routes()
#   system           load_system()
#   boxes            the box-file passes: fast_scan(), or scan_all_boxes()
#                    if it fails, then read_all_boxes()
#   orders           load_orders()
#   check            check_db()
#   edges            determine_map_edges()
#   load             what load_db() runs of these, in its order: trade,
#                    system, boxes, orders, check, edges
#   posts            cleanup_posts()
#   savetrade        save_trade_routes()
#   savesystem       save_system()
#   saveboxes        write_all_boxes() and write_master()
#   saveorders       save_orders()
#   rename           rename_act_join_files()
#   save             what save_db() runs of these, in its order: posts,
#                    savetrade, savesystem, saveboxes, saveorders, rename
#   print            the globals: sysclock, the settings in lib/system,
#                    max_map_row, max_map_col, max_map_init, the trade-route
#                    state (have_seed, seed, secret), and each player's
#                    order queues, "orders PLAYER UNIT: [ORDER]..."
#
# The special players are 100 (independent), 200 (gm), 202 (skill), 203
# (eat), 206 (npc) and 207 (garrison).

section a whole load and save
# A small game with lib/system and orders for player 1001: load, print
# and save, as load_db() and save_db() run these routines.
mkdir lib
mkdir lib/fact
put lib/loc
put lib/item
put lib/skill
put lib/gate
put lib/road
put lib/ship
put lib/unform
putl lib/misc 100 player pl_npc
putl lib/misc na Independent player
putl lib/misc
putl lib/misc 200 player pl_system
putl lib/misc na Gamemaster
putl lib/misc PL
putl lib/misc  pw secret
putl lib/misc
putl lib/misc 202 player pl_system
putl lib/misc na Skill list
putl lib/misc
putl lib/misc 203 player pl_system
putl lib/misc na Order eater
putl lib/misc
putl lib/misc 206 player pl_silent
putl lib/misc na NPC control
putl lib/misc
putl lib/misc 207 player pl_silent
putl lib/misc na Garrison units
putl lib/misc
putl lib/misc 1001 player pl_regular
putl lib/misc na Player one
putl lib/misc PL
putl lib/misc  un 1002
putl lib/misc
putl lib/misc 1002 char 0
putl lib/misc na Noble
putl lib/misc LI
putl lib/misc  wh 10101
putl lib/misc CH
putl lib/misc  lo 1001
putl lib/misc
putl lib/misc 10001 loc region
putl lib/misc na Region
putl lib/misc LI
putl lib/misc  hl 10101
putl lib/misc
putl lib/misc 10101 loc plain
putl lib/misc na Plain
putl lib/misc LI
putl lib/misc  wh 10001
putl lib/misc  hl 1002
putl lib/misc
mkdir lib/orders
putl lib/system sysclock: 12 3 45
putl lib/system indep_player=100
putl lib/system gm_player=200
putl lib/system skill_player=202
putl lib/system from_host=host@example.com (A Host)
putl lib/system reply_host=reply@example.com
putl lib/system gm_address=gm@example.com
putl lib/system game_title=Test Game
putl lib/system game_url=http://g
putl lib/system rules_url=http://r
putl lib/system times_url=http://t
putl lib/system htpasswd_loc=/x/ht
putl lib/system garrison_pay=3
putl lib/system auto_quit=6
putl lib/system army_slow_factor=25
putl lib/system post=1
putl lib/system init=1
putl lib/system fr=0
putl lib/system tr=0
putl lib/system ur=0
putl lib/system fp=0
putl lib/system hr=0
putl lib/system hp=0
putl lib/system hl=0
putl lib/system nr=0
putl lib/system nl=0
putl lib/system np=206
putl lib/system cr=0
putl lib/system cp=210
putl lib/system mo=10101
putl lib/orders/1001 1002:move north
putl lib/orders/1001 1002:study 610
putl lib/orders/1001 1001:# a note
load
print
save

section load_system: every line
# Comments, blank lines, white space and control bytes, a partial
# sysclock, junk after numbers, prefixes that are not recognized, a value
# that is empty, and a last line with no newline.
mkdir lib
putl lib/system # a comment
putl lib/system
putl lib/system    
putl lib/system 	sysclock: 7
putl lib/system   from_host=  spaced host  	
putl lib/system reply_host=
putl lib/system gm_address=a\x01b\x7fc
putl lib/system game_title=Caf\xe9 \xe9x
putl lib/system game_url=u\x00v
putl lib/system garrison_pay=12abc
putl lib/system auto_quit=-4
putl lib/system army_slow_factor= +9
putl lib/system indep_player=0x10
putl lib/system gm_player=99999999999
putl lib/system skill_player=-2147483649
putl lib/system postx=1
putl lib/system post=7
putl lib/system init=
putl lib/system FR=3
putl lib/system fr=10002
putl lib/system tr=10003
putl lib/system ur=10004
putl lib/system fp=300
putl lib/system hr=10005
putl lib/system hp=10006
putl lib/system hl=301
putl lib/system nr=10007
putl lib/system nl=10008
putl lib/system np=302
putl lib/system cr=10009
putl lib/system cp=211
putl lib/system mo=0
putl lib/system sysclock:
putl lib/system times_url=a\rb\r
putl lib/system rules_url=x\\y
putl lib/system htpasswd_loc=last
put lib/system unknown=last line
system
print
savesystem

section load_system: sysclock values
# A later sysclock line scans over an earlier one; fields it does not
# give keep their values.
mkdir lib
putl lib/system sysclock: 1 2 3
putl lib/system sysclock: 40000 -5
putl lib/system mo=-1
putl lib/system auto_quit=0
system
print
savesystem

section load_system: a long line
# getlin() reads a line of any length; the last line, without a
# newline, is cut to 1023 bytes.
mkdir lib
putl lib/system game_
put lib/system game_
system
print
savesystem

section load_system: no file
# A diagnostic, and the globals keep their initial values;
# save_system() writes them, without a sysclock line.
mkdir lib
system
print
savesystem

section load_system: system is a directory
# It opens and reads as empty; it cannot be written.
mkdir lib
mkdir lib/system
system
print
savesystem

section load_system: unreadable
# A file that cannot be read.
mkdir lib
putl lib/system gm_player=5
chmod 000 lib/system
system
print
chmod 644 lib/system

section save_system: no directory
# libdir does not exist.
savesystem

section trade routes: none
# The default secret; save_trade_routes() writes nothing.
mkdir lib
trade
print
savetrade

section trade routes: lib/trade_routes
# A continuing game's seed wins, and is written back.
mkdir lib
putl lib/trade_routes 12345
putl lib/trade-route-seed 777
trade
print
savetrade

section trade routes: lib/trade_routes and -G
# -G is ignored, with a warning.
mkdir lib
putl lib/trade_routes 12345
seed 0x10
trade
print
savetrade

section trade routes: -G
# -G wins over lib/trade-route-seed, and is written to lib/trade_routes.
mkdir lib
putl lib/trade-route-seed 777
seed 0x10
trade
print
savetrade

section trade routes: -G 0
# A seed of 0 is a seed.
mkdir lib
seed 0
trade
print
savetrade

section trade routes: lib/trade-route-seed
# The input file seeds a new game, which keeps it in lib/trade_routes.
mkdir lib
putl lib/trade-route-seed  \t\n 18446744073709551615 junk
trade
print
savetrade

section trade routes: lib/trade-route-seed is not a number
# The default stays, and nothing is written.
mkdir lib
putl lib/trade-route-seed x1
trade
print
savetrade

section trade routes: lib/trade_routes is not a number
# It still wins: the default stays, -G and the input file are ignored.
mkdir lib
putl lib/trade_routes abc
putl lib/trade-route-seed 5
seed 9
trade
print
savetrade

section trade routes: lib/trade_routes is a directory
# It opens, and does not scan; it wins, and -G is ignored.
mkdir lib
mkdir lib/trade_routes
seed 9
trade
print
savetrade

section trade routes: lib/trade_routes is empty
mkdir lib
put lib/trade_routes
trade
print

section trade routes: lib/trade_routes a minus sign
mkdir lib
putl lib/trade_routes -5
trade
print
savetrade

section trade routes: lib/trade_routes a plus sign
mkdir lib
putl lib/trade_routes +7
trade
print
savetrade

section trade routes: lib/trade_routes a sign alone
mkdir lib
putl lib/trade_routes -
trade
print
savetrade

section trade routes: lib/trade_routes overflow
mkdir lib
putl lib/trade_routes 99999999999999999999999
trade
print
savetrade

section trade routes: lib/trade_routes a negative overflow
mkdir lib
putl lib/trade_routes -99999999999999999999999
trade
print
savetrade

section trade routes: lib/trade_routes leading zeros
mkdir lib
putl lib/trade_routes 0000000000000000000042
trade
print
savetrade

section trade routes: lib/trade_routes 511 zeros
mkdir lib
putl lib/trade_routes 
trade
print
savetrade

section trade routes: lib/trade_routes 512 zeros
mkdir lib
putl lib/trade_routes 
trade
print
savetrade

section trade routes: lib/trade_routes 600 zeros
mkdir lib
putl lib/trade_routes 
trade
print
savetrade

section trade routes: lib/trade_routes a sign and 511 zeros
mkdir lib
putl lib/trade_routes 
trade
print
savetrade

section trade routes: lib/trade_routes hexadecimal
mkdir lib
putl lib/trade_routes 0x1f
trade
print
savetrade

section trade routes: lib/trade_routes no newline
mkdir lib
put lib/trade_routes 8
trade
print
savetrade

section trade routes: cannot write
# -G sets a seed, and libdir does not exist.
seed 1
trade
print
savetrade

section load_orders: order files
# Lines with and without a ':', an empty line, unit 0, white space, a
# file whose name is not a number, a number with no box, a hidden file,
# and orders for the gm player. Units that are not boxes keep their
# queues, but save_orders() skips them.
mkdir lib
mkdir lib/fact
put lib/loc
put lib/item
put lib/skill
put lib/gate
put lib/road
put lib/ship
put lib/unform
putl lib/misc 100 player pl_npc
putl lib/misc na Independent player
putl lib/misc
putl lib/misc 200 player pl_system
putl lib/misc na Gamemaster
putl lib/misc PL
putl lib/misc  pw secret
putl lib/misc
putl lib/misc 202 player pl_system
putl lib/misc na Skill list
putl lib/misc
putl lib/misc 203 player pl_system
putl lib/misc na Order eater
putl lib/misc
putl lib/misc 206 player pl_silent
putl lib/misc na NPC control
putl lib/misc
putl lib/misc 207 player pl_silent
putl lib/misc na Garrison units
putl lib/misc
putl lib/misc 1001 player pl_regular
putl lib/misc na Player one
putl lib/misc PL
putl lib/misc  un 1002
putl lib/misc
putl lib/misc 1002 char 0
putl lib/misc na Noble
putl lib/misc LI
putl lib/misc  wh 10101
putl lib/misc CH
putl lib/misc  lo 1001
putl lib/misc
putl lib/misc 10001 loc region
putl lib/misc na Region
putl lib/misc LI
putl lib/misc  hl 10101
putl lib/misc
putl lib/misc 10101 loc plain
putl lib/misc na Plain
putl lib/misc LI
putl lib/misc  wh 10001
putl lib/misc  hl 1002
putl lib/misc
mkdir lib/orders
putl lib/orders/1001 1002:move north
putl lib/orders/1001 1002:  study 610  
putl lib/orders/1001 no colon here
putl lib/orders/1001
putl lib/orders/1001 1001:a:b:c
putl lib/orders/1001  1002 :x
putl lib/orders/1001 5555:not a box
putl lib/orders/1001 0:zero
putl lib/orders/1001 1002:
putl lib/orders/1001 1002:\tTAB
put lib/orders/1001 1002:last line
putl lib/orders/200 1002:gm order
putl lib/orders/abc 1002:skipped
putl lib/orders/.1001 1002:skipped
putl lib/orders/999 1002:no box
putl lib/orders/0 1002:no box
boxes
orders
print
saveorders

section determine_map_edges

# region while any special region is 0.

mkdir lib/fact
put lib/loc
put lib/item
put lib/skill

putl lib/misc

putl lib/misc na Faery
putl lib/misc LI
putl lib/misc  hl 15599
putl lib/misc
putl lib/misc 10101 loc plain
putl lib/misc LI
putl lib/misc  wh 10001
putl lib/misc
putl lib/misc 10512 loc forest
putl lib/misc LI
putl lib/misc  wh 10001
putl lib/misc

putl lib/misc LI
putl lib/misc  wh 10001
putl lib/misc

putl lib/misc LI
putl lib/misc  wh 10002
putl lib/misc
putl lib/misc 19999 loc plain
putl lib/misc
putl lib/system fr=10002

edges

section rename_act_join_files

mkdir act/1001
putl act/1001/Join-g3 join

newplayer 1005
